planSteps.description: Set the viewport to 390x844 and navigate to /
The page has no horizontal scroll (document scrollWidth is at most 390) and 'nav-dashboard' is visible
Scroll 'hero-demo' into view and wait until 'demo-play' is enabled; click 'demo-step'
Navigate to /app?election=alaska-2022-special at 390px and wait for 'result'
'kpi-winner' reads 'Peltola, Mary S.', and election buttons are visible in a two-column grid with no horizontal page scroll
